Compiled on 9/4/2021

Notes:  

The band announced earlier in the day that "a potential exposure to the Covid-19 virus within the organization has taken place. In the best interest of everyone's health and safety, Dave Matthews Band will perform this weekend's shows in an alternate format." Dave announced at the beginning of Dumpstaphunk's set that Carter and Stefan would not be playing at the shows, and before Allen Stone's set, he said specifically that they had tested positive for COVID-19.
